task.title: P6-010: Give the hosted data path the session fallback fetch_current_user already has
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, /my collection page, tree and collection header). Original id: P6-010. Size: S. Specs: specs/auth.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Give the hosted data path the session fallback `fetch_current_user` already has, so an idle `/my/*` tab stops claiming the session expired when it hasn't.** Verified 2026-07-28 (`specs/phase-6-probes/P6-010.md`, CONFIRMED). Both credentials carry a 900 s life, so after 15 minutes idle the `tr_jwt` cookie is *gone*: `fetch_current_user` (`app/src/account.rs:320-344`), which `RequireAuth` awaits, falls back to `tr_session` and re-establishes — the guard passes; `user_id_from_headers` (`app/src/auth.rs:233-239`) has no such fallback, so the same SSR pass renders `data-failure="session"` over a fully resolved user. `app/src/my/tree.rs:40-51` awaits the user *before* the reads, so the ordering is deterministic, not a race. Self-heals on one reload (the response did refresh the JWT), needs a 15-minute idle window, and most users never hit it — **low priority**, which is why it left §1 on verification. **Hosted only** — the native arm already re-mints and retries once (`app/src/native.rs:115-145`), though none of that code lifts: it keys off a 401 `reqwest::Response` and the hosted path fails earlier.

**Fix (S):** add the fallback to `collection_backend()`'s hosted arm alone (`app/src/lib.rs:834-842`) — one shared helper, all 23 call sites unchanged. Reuse the body of `fetch_current_user`'s fallback (`account.rs:325-338`: read `tr_session` → `mint_jwt` → `verify_token`) **minus the cookie writes**; it need only resolve a `user_id`, since `fetch_current_user` already refreshes `tr_jwt` on the same response. Not in `routes.rs`'s `session_backend`/`catalog_backend` — those are shared with plain-axum handlers that have no Leptos `ResponseOptions` context, and their native callers re-mint for themselves. `upstream::mint_jwt` is a real HTTP round trip to Better Auth, so it needs "exactly once, then surface the 401" discipline. Optionally extend to the catalog half (`lib.rs:305,408`) if `/catalog` ownership blocks should survive the window too.

**Acceptance:** with only a valid `tr_session` cookie and no `tr_jwt`, a document request to `/my/all` renders no `data-failure="session"` and still carries `Set-Cookie: tr_jwt=`. Landing this makes the rationale comment on the unit test at `app/src/my/tree.rs:726-739` stale (the assertion stays correct) and supersedes the mechanism write-up at `specs/app-ui.md:439-462`.
